subject_line: Kamphoer se lewe in Frans as Fille à soldats
email_body:
Beste Francois,

Ek het gelees dat Kamphoer, met sy wortels in die Anglo-Boereoorlog, in Naomi Morgan se vertaling as Fille à soldats in Frans verskyn het, die roman se derde vertaling. Dit het my laat wonder hoe dit voel om 'n verhaal wat so diep in Suid-Afrikaanse geskiedenis gewortel is, in 'n ander taal te sien lewe. Wat het jy oor die boek self ontdek deur daardie vertaalproses?

The Author Ledger is 'n onafhanklike projek wat kort Author Spotlights publiseer. Die portret word ontwikkel aan die hand van 'n paar geskrewe vrae wat die skrywer op sy eie tyd kan beantwoord, en die volledige teks word vir hersiening met hom gedeel voor publikasie.

Sal jy daarvoor oop wees om deel te neem? Geen druk nie.

Vriendelike groete,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: Kamphoer (2014, Anglo-Boer War) translated into French as Fille a soldats by UFS colleague Naomi Morgan, its third translation (UFS news 2021); Smith is senior lecturer, MA Creative Writing, UFS. Email seen in search result (UFS dept contact page + 2025/2026 Humanities rule books).

book_title: The Eastern Gate: War and Peace in Nagaland, Manipur and India's Far East
subject_line: From Red Sun to The Eastern Gate: a question about the Northeast
email_body:
Dear Sudeep,

The Eastern Gate, longlisted for the Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize, reads to me as a return to ground you first walked in Highway 39, a decade on. With Fallen City now out from Aleph, I'm curious what changed in how you approach Nagaland and Manipur between those two books, and what you felt you could only say the second time.

The Author Ledger is an independent project featuring short Author Spotlights. The portrait is developed through a few written questions, which you can answer at your own pace, and the full text is shared with you for review before publication.

Would you be open to taking part? No pressure either way.

Best regards,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: Ahmedabad University profile: The Eastern Gate (Simon & Schuster 2022) longlisted for Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize 2023; Highway 39 (2012); latest Fallen City (Aleph, Aug 2024). Email seen in search result (faculty profile).
